authorized_remote_route_after_product_ga: Use .github/workflows/release.yml (Hosted release) by workflow_dispatch on main, with an immutable 40-character aidream_sha and release note. Its ubuntu-latest job installs frozen dependencies, refreshes @ai-matrx packages, and invokes scripts/release-with-gate-auth.mjs, which runs release.sh with the strict gates and Store risk check.

A successful job verifies the pushed source/tag and release receipt, then uploads matrx-extend-v<version> containing the validated -store.zip, -local.zip, release-receipt.json, and log. Identify the candidate from that receipt and verify the Store ZIP hash; do not infer eligibility from package.json version or a development artifact.

Run exact-artifact hosted guest and member acceptance through .github/workflows/hosted-guest-acceptance.yml with release_run_id and inspect the results. The workflow accepts only a successful Hosted release run with one unexpired versioned artifact for this mode.

After the guest/member gates pass, upload only the validated -store.zip to the primary Matrx publisher item, submit with automatic publication enabled, and verify Pending review. Routine release and dashboard actions are already authorized by the chrome-web-store-release skill; only an unsatisfied live Google 2FA challenge is a normal human handoff.
